headline: Linn Mercy Reawakens While Godcrofts Battle Holds Fast
war_summary: Since the last edition Linn Mercy has come back to life with eight flips in two hours and thirty-seven in the day about Lathair and Outwich Ranch, listed at two Warden, eight Colonial and one neutral post, while Godcrofts keeps its pace at eleven in two hours and thirty-seven in the day about Isawa, Fleecewatch and Ursa Base, listed at one Warden, five Colonial and three neutral. Marban Hollow holds at six in two hours and thirty-eight in the day about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, listed at four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral, and Palantine Berm cools to four in two hours against forty-five in the day about Vendett and Windburn Landing, listed at three Warden and four Colonial. Stlican Shelf eases to two in two hours against sixteen in the day at Breaker Town, while Weathered Expanse, Stonecradle and Farranac Coast show no change in two hours despite forty, twenty-one and seven in the day, and Callahan's Passage again shows sharp losses with no flip in the day.
